camel_example: aliyun sas AddIdcProbe --region cn-hangzhou --IdcName test --WinPort 40 --IdcRegion Hangzhou --LinuxPort 40 --IntervalPeriod 1 --IpSegments '192.168.XX.XX/24' --Uuids '076a446d-df7d-424c-bdc5-bb5dc7f10000' --PeriodUnit day
description_en: Creates an IDC probe to add assets in a data center to Security Center and manage the assets by using the Security Center console
description_zh: 新增IDC探针，将本地数据中心IDC（Internet Data Center）中的资产接入到云安全中心，通过云安全中心控制台统一管理IDC资产信息
kebab_example: aliyun sas add-idc-probe --idc-name test --ip-segments 192.168.XX.XX/24 --win-port 40 --linux-port 40 --idc-region Hangzhou --period-unit day --interval-period 1 --uuids 076a446d-df7d-424c-bdc5-bb5dc7f10000 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddIdcProbe

parameters.help_en: The name of the data center
parameters.name: idc_name

parameters.help_en: The settings of the CIDR block
parameters.name: ip_segments

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the scan interval. Valid values:

*   **day**
*   **hour**
parameters.help_zh:
扫描周期的单位，取值：
- **day**：天。
- **hour**：小时
parameters.name: period_unit

parameters.help_en:
The UUID of the server. Separate multiple UUIDs with commas (,).

>  You can call the [DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~) operation to query the UUID
parameters.help_zh:
服务器UUID。多个UUID采用英文半角逗号分隔。
> 调用[DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~)接口获取该参数
parameters.name: uuids
